# Mac default-client checks compare bundle identifiers and keep error cleanup separate

nsMacShellService uses LSCopyDefaultHandlerForURLScheme to obtain an identifier and compares it with CFBundleGetIdentifier for the main bundle. The setter passes that identifier to LSSetDefaultHandlerForURLScheme and returns NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED on nonzero status. In the inspected setter, that error return occurs after CFRetain and before CFRelease; preserve this exact static cleanup gap when reviewing guard changes. No error or leak was reproduced. The bug reopened after this migration and the later fix disabled the Mac test. The fixed manifest still excludes Mac, so the existing set-then-is-default assertions do not establish passing Mac coverage.

Scope: Mac shell default application integration.
